title: AddFallDamageOnLand (spell flag)
html:
AddFallDamageOnLand is a spell flag which determines whether fall damage can be caused by an action. If set, sufficient vertical will deal fall damage according to the falling damage rules. This flag is set on most jump abilities and most actions which forcibly move a target.

Movement, forced or otherwise, caused by actions without this flag will not trigger fall damage. Examples of such movement abilities include  Diving Strike or any form of  Fly. For forced movement abilities, this flag is fairly consistently applied, but there are a few exceptions such as:

  •  Black Hole
  •  Water Whip: Pull
  •  Storm's Fury
  •  Claws (Badger)
  •  Claws (Owlbear)
  •  Zephyr Flash
  •  Grand Slam

Because they are missing this spell flag, these actions cannot cause fall damage when pushing or pulling targets off ledges.

The behaviour of chasms is not affected by this flag.
